info.name: Nextcloud DAV event dispatcher
info.summary: Drains the nextcloud-dav sidecar event outbox and dispatches CardDAV events
info.description:
Companion app for the `nextcloud-dav` CardDAV sidecar.
The sidecar performs native `PUT`/`DELETE` and writes an outbox row in the same database transaction as the card write. This app owns the outbox table (`<prefix>dav_event_outbox`) and ships a resident worker (`occ dav:event-dispatch`) that dispatches the real `CardCreatedEvent` / `CardUpdatedEvent` / `CardDeletedEvent` through Nextcloud's normal listeners (activity, birthday calendar, photo cache, push, webhooks).
A background job (`OutboxJanitor`) re-arms stale reservations and removes done rows past the retention window.
info.author: nextcloud-dav contributors
